<transformation>
The input is treated as a tile map. The output is NxM times larger than the input (where the input is N rows x M cols). Each input cell at (BR, BC) with a non-zero value causes a copy of the full input to be placed in the corresponding NxM block of the output (at rows BR*N .. BR*N+N-1, cols BC*M .. BC*M+M-1). Each input cell with value 0 produces an all-zero block at that position.
</transformation>

<asp>
% Count distinct row/col indices — equals grid dimensions for 0-indexed inputs
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{R : input(R, _, _)}.
n_cols(N) :- N = #count{C : input(_, C, _)}.

% Output is NR*NR rows and NC*NC cols (input tiled by itself)
output_cell(R, C) :-
    input(BR, BC, _), input(DR, DC, _),
    n_rows(NR), n_cols(NC),
    R = BR*NR + DR, C = BC*NC + DC.

1 { output(R, C, Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- output_cell(R, C).

% Non-zero block: the sub-cell must equal the input value at the relative position
:- input(BR, BC, V), V != 0,
   input(DR, DC, TileColor),
   n_rows(NR), n_cols(NC),
   R = BR*NR + DR, C = BC*NC + DC,
   output(R, C, ActualColor), ActualColor != TileColor.

% Zero block: every sub-cell must be 0
:- input(BR, BC, 0),
   input(DR, DC, _),
   n_rows(NR), n_cols(NC),
   R = BR*NR + DR, C = BC*NC + DC,
   output(R, C, ActualColor), ActualColor != 0.
</asp>
</example_1>

<transformation>
The output is the same size as the input. Color-3 cells are unchanged. Non-3 cells (value 0) that are enclosed by color-3 walls — i.e., cannot reach the grid boundary via 4-connected movement through non-3 cells — are filled with color 4. All other non-3 cells remain 0.

<asp>
% Output has the same dimensions as the input
output_cell(R, C) :- input(R, C, _).
1 { output(R, C, Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- output_cell(R, C).

% Grid boundary coordinates
min_row(R) :- R = #min{Row : input(Row, _, _)}.
max_row(R) :- R = #max{Row : input(Row, _, _)}.
min_col(C) :- C = #min{Col : input(_, Col, _)}.
max_col(C) :- C = #max{Col : input(_, Col, _)}.

% 4-connected adjacency offsets
delta(0,1). delta(0,-1). delta(1,0). delta(-1,0).

% Non-3 cells on the grid boundary are reachable from outside
outside(R, C) :- input(R, C, V), V != 3, min_row(Rmin), R = Rmin.
outside(R, C) :- input(R, C, V), V != 3, max_row(Rmax), R = Rmax.
outside(R, C) :- input(R, C, V), V != 3, min_col(Cmin), C = Cmin.
outside(R, C) :- input(R, C, V), V != 3, max_col(Cmax), C = Cmax.

% Flood-fill outward through non-3 cells
outside(R2, C2) :-
    outside(R1, C1), delta(DR, DC),
    R2 = R1+DR, C2 = C1+DC,
    input(R2, C2, V), V != 3.

% Color-3 cells stay 3
:- input(R, C, 3), output(R, C, Color), Color != 3.

% Outside non-3 cells stay 0
:- outside(R, C), output(R, C, Color), Color != 0.

% Interior non-3 cells (enclosed by 3s, not reachable from boundary) become 4
:- input(R, C, 0), not outside(R, C), output(R, C, Color), Color != 4.
</asp>

% ---------------------------------------------------------------
% Gravity per column transformation:
%   – All non‑zero cells in a column “drop” to the bottom of that column,
%     preserving their top‑to‑bottom order.
%   – Cells that do not receive a non‑zero become 0.
% ---------------------------------------------------------------

% grid dimensions
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{R : input(R,_,_)}.
n_cols(M) :- M = #count{C : input(_,C,_)}.

% number of non‑zero cells in each column
col_nz_cnt(C,Kc) :- Kc = #count{R : input(R,C,V), V != 0}.

% relative index (topmost = 0) of each non‑zero cell inside its column
col_nz_idx(C,Rin,V,Idx) :-
    input(Rin,C,V), V != 0,
    Idx = #count{R2 : input(R2,C,V2), V2 != 0, R2 < Rin}.

% place every non‑zero cell after gravity
output(Rout, Cin, V) :-
    col_nz_idx(Cin,Rin,V,Idx),
    col_nz_cnt(Cin,Kc),
    n_rows(N),
    Rout = (N - Kc) + Idx,
    color(V).

% keep the total number of non‑zero cells unchanged
total_input_nonzero = #count{R,C,V : input(R,C,V), V != 0}.
total_output_nonzero = #count{R,C,V : output(R,C,V), V != 0}.
1 { total_output_nonzero = total_input_nonzero } 1.

% domain of the output grid (same size as the input)
cell(R,C) :- R < N, C < M.

% exactly one colour for each cell
1 { output(R,C,Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- cell(R,C).

% a cell that receives a non‑zero value
mapped(R,C) :- output(R,C,V), V != 0.

% cells without a non‑zero become zero
output(R,C,0) :- cell(R,C), not mapped(R,C).

% a non‑zero may only appear where the cell is mapped
:- not mapped(R,C), output(R,C,Color), Color != 0.

% Grid boundary coordinates
min_row(R) :- R = #min{Row : input(Row, _, _)}.
max_row(R) :- R = #max{Row : input(Row, _, _)}.
min_col(C) :- C = #min{Col : input(_, Col, _)}.
max_col(C) :- C = #max{Col : input(_, Col, _)}.

% 4-connected adjacency offsets

% Non-3 cells on the grid boundary are reachable from outside
outside(R, C) :- input(R, C, V), V != 3, min_row(Rmin), R = Rmin.
outside(R, C) :- input(R, C, V), V != 3, max_row(Rmax), R = Rmax.
outside(R, C) :- input(R, C, V), V != 3, min_col(Cmin), C = Cmin.
outside(R, C) :- input(R, C, V), V != 3, max_col(Cmax), C = Cmax.

% Flood-fill outward through non-3 cells
outside(R2, C2) :-
    outside(R1, C1), delta(DR, DC),
    R2 = R1+DR, C2 = C1+DC,
    input(R2, C2, V), V != 3.

:- input(R, C, 0), not outside(R, C), output(R, C, Color), Color != 4.

% ---------------------------------------------------------------
%  ARC‑AGI transformation:
%  1.  Gravity per column – all non‑zero cells “drop” to the
%      bottom of their column, preserving top‑to‑bottom order.
%  2.  If the column immediately to the left of the right‑most
%      column that contains a non‑zero cell is empty, the whole
%      right‑most non‑zero column is shifted left by one position.
% ---------------------------------------------------------------

% ----------  dimensions  ----------
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{R : input(R,_,_)}.
n_cols(M) :- M = #count{C : input(_,C,_)}.

% ----------  which column has any non‑zero input ? ----------
col_has_input_nonzero(C) :- input(R,C,V), V != 0.
Rmax = #max{C : col_has_input_nonzero(C)}.                % right‑most column with any input value

% ----------  is a column completely empty ? ----------
col_is_empty(C) :-
    #count{R : input(R,C,V), V != 0} = 0.

% ----------  shift flag (rule 2) ----------
shift :-
    Rmax > 0,
    col_is_empty(Rmax-1),
    col_has_input_nonzero(Rmax).    % the right‑most column is non‑empty and the one just left of it is empty

% ----------  per‑column count of input non‑zeros ----------
col_input_nonzero_cnt(C,K) :- K = #count{R : input(R,C,V), V != 0}.

% ----------  relative index of a non‑zero cell inside its column ----------
rel_index(Rin,Cin,V,Idx) :-
    Idx = #count{R2 : input(R2,Cin,V2), V2 != 0, R2 < Rin}.

% ----------  placement after gravity (case A) ----------
%   when the column is **not** shifted (or the column is left of the shifted block)
output(R,C,V) :-
    not (shift, C_in >= Rmax),          % column is not the shifted one
    input(Rin,Cin,V), V != 0,
    col_input_nonzero_cnt(Cin,Kc),
    rel_index(Rin,Cin,V,Idx),
    R = (N - Kc) + Idx,                   % drop to the bottom of that column
    C = Cin.

% ----------  placement after gravity (case B) ----------
%   when the column is the shifted block (its non‑zeros move one column left)
output(R,C,V) :-
    shift,
    Cin >= Rmax,
    input(Rin,Cin,V), V != 0,
    col_input_nonzero_cnt(Cin,Kc),
    rel_index(Rin,Cin,V,Idx),
    R = (N - Kc) + Idx,
    C = Cin - 1.                          % shift the whole column left by one

% ----------  total number of non‑zero cells must stay the same ----------
total_input_nonzero = #count{R,C,V : input(R,C,V), V != 0}.
total_output_nonzero = #count{R,C,V : output(R,C,V), V != 0}.
1 { total_output_nonzero = total_input_nonzero } 1.

% (the count constraint above together with the placement rules make

% Dimensions
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{R : input(R,_,_)}.
n_cols(M) :- M = #count{C : input(_,C,_)}.

% Count non-zero cells in each column
col_nz_cnt(C,Kc) :- Kc = #count{R : input(R,C,V), V != 0}.

% Order index of a non-zero cell (number of non-zero cells above it in its column)
col_nz_ord(Rin,Cin,V,Idx) :-
    input(Rin,Cin,V), V != 0,
    Idx = #count{R2 : input(R2, Cin, V2), V2 != 0, R2 < Rin}.

% Mapping of a non-zero cell to its final position (gravity)
is_nonzero_placement(R,C,V) :-
    input(Rin,Cin,V), V != 0,
    col_nz_cnt(Cin,Kc),
    Idx = #count{R2 : input(R2, Cin, V2), V2 != 0, R2 < Rin},
    n_rows(N),
    R = (N - Kc) + Idx,
    C = Cin.

% Define all output positions (same size as input)
cell(R,C) :-
    n_rows(N), n_cols(M),
    R < N,
    C < M.

% Exactly one output per cell
1 { output(R, C, Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- cell(R, C).

% Non-zero cells must appear exactly where they belong and have the correct value
:- output(R, C, Color), is_nonzero_placement(R, C, V), Color != V.

% Cells that are not mapped must be zero
is_mapped(R, C) :- is_nonzero_placement(R, C, V).
:- not is_mapped(R, C), output(R, C, Color), Color != 0.

% End of program

% Dimensions
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{R : input(R,_,_)}.
n_cols(M) :- M = #count{C : input(_,C,_)}.

% Number of non-zero cells in each column
col_nz_cnt(C, Kc) :- Kc = #count{R : input(R, C, V), V != 0}.

% Mapping of a non-zero cell to its final position after gravity (drop to bottom of column)
is_nonzero_placement(R, C, V) :-
    input(Rin, Cin, V), V != 0,
    col_nz_cnt(Cin, Kc),
    Idx = #count{R2 : input(R2, Cin, V2), V2 != 0, R2 < Rin},
    n_rows(N),
    R = (N - Kc) + Idx,
    C = Cin.

% All output cells (same size as the input)
cell(R, C) :-
    n_rows(N), n_cols(M),
    R < N,
    C < M.
1 { output(R, C, Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- cell(R, C).

% For a cell that is a non-zero placement the colour must be the input value
:- output(R, C, Color), is_nonzero_placement(R, C, V), Color != V.

% Cells that are not the result of a non-zero placement must be zero
is_mapped(R, C) :- is_nonzero_placement(R, C, V).
:- not is_mapped(R, C), output(R, C, Color), Color != 0.

%  ARC‑AGI transformation:
%  1.  Gravity per column – all non‑zero cells “drop” to the

n_cols(M) :- M = #count{C : input(_,C,_)}.

col_has_input_nonzero(C) :- input(R,C,V), V != 0.
Rmax = #max{C : col_has_input_nonzero(C)}.                % right‑most column with any input value

% ----------  is a column completely empty ? ----------
col_is_empty(C) :-
    #count{R : input(R,C,V), V != 0} = 0.

% ----------  shift flag (rule 2) ----------
shift :-
    Rmax > 0,
    col_is_empty(Rmax-1),
    col_has_input_nonzero(Rmax).    % the right‑most column is non‑empty and the one just left of it is empty

% ----------  per‑column count of input non‑zeros ----------
col_input_nonzero_cnt(C,K) :- K = #count{R : input(R,C,V), V != 0}.

% ----------  relative index of a non‑zero cell inside its column ----------
rel_index(Rin,Cin,V,Idx) :-

    R = (N - Kc) + Idx,                   % drop to the bottom of that column
    C = Cin.

% ----------  placement after gravity (case B) ----------
%   when the column is the shifted block (its non‑zeros move one column left)

% Determine grid size
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{R : input(R,_,_)}.
n_cols(M) :- M = #count{C : input(_,C,_)}.

% Count non-zero cells per column
col_nz_cnt(C,Kc) :- Kc = #count{R : input(R, C, V), V != 0}.

% For each non-zero cell, compute its relative order (topmost has order 0)
col_nz_order(C,Rin,V,Idx) :-
    input(Rin, C, V), V != 0,
    Idx = #count{R2 : input(R2, C, V2), V2 != 0, R2 < Rin}.

% Mapping: place each non-zero cell at its final position
output(Rout, Cin, V) :-
    col_nz_order(Cin, Rin, V, Idx),
    col_nz_cnt(Cin, Kc),
    n_rows(N),
    Rout = (N - Kc) + Idx,
    color(V).

% Ensure total number of non-zero cells preserved
total_input_nonzero = #count{R,C,V : input(R,C,V), V != 0}.
total_output_nonzero = #count{R,C,V : output(R,C,V), V != 0}.
1 { total_output_nonzero = total_input_nonzero } 1.

% Define the set of cells in the output grid
cell(R,C) :- R < N, C < M.

% Exactly one colour per cell
1 { output(R,C,Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- cell(R,C).

% Predicate: a cell that got a non‑zero value
mapped(R,C) :- output(R,C,V), V != 0.

% Cells that have no non‑zero must become zero
output(R,C,0) :- cell(R,C), not mapped(R,C).

% No non‑zero may appear where a cell is not mapped
:- not mapped(R,C), output(R,C,Color), Color != 0.

% end
